prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. ONE finished VERTICAL PORTRAIT comic panel for Nightglass Courier19, showing the next physical rescue moment after reference4. No panels-within-panel. Reference1 gives elegant original anime drawing and inhabited vertical navy city, not its poster composition or glass ray. Reference2 gives adult Aren and older Pell identities/clothing, not tool rigs or carried objects. Reference3 gives fixed upper bridge anchor, empty maintenance car shape, current ragged jacket hem and right-hand crescent. Reference4 is immediately preceding SELECTED grip/release: Pell's RIGHT hand holds Aren's LEFT forearm, Pell has unclipped the rail tether from his harness. Maintain that anatomical hand ownership during flight. The open snap has now been dropped back into the car. No creature in this new panel. NO text, captions, balloons, generated labels or interfaces; reserve some calm upper-left city/fog area for later short editable speech.

CAMERA AND BODY OWNERSHIP ARE ESSENTIAL: view BOTH ADULTS FROM BEHIND in a wide REAR-THREE-QUARTER view, with Aren's WHITE JACKET BACK facing the viewer unmistakably. Show broad ivory BACK fabric, not his front black shirt. Aren's head turned slightly toward destination, back of midnight hair dominant, only small cheek profile. Because we are behind him, his anatomical RIGHT shoulder/arm is picture RIGHT, raised UP-RIGHT holding his single crescent sword. His anatomical LEFT shoulder/arm is picture LEFT, extending DOWN-LEFT to support Pell through their secure reciprocal forearm grip. Pell trails lower-left and grips Aren's left forearm with Pell's anatomical RIGHT hand. Show Pell from behind/slight side too: mustard jacket back and worn harness, gray hair, his right shoulder nearest Aren at picture right; his LEFT arm hangs free and EMPTY, no clip or weapon held. Exactly two people, four arms, no extra hands. Both whole adult bodies visible and separate, legs trailing naturally toward lower-left.

ONE FORCE PATH: the cyan line starts EXACTLY at the cyan POMMEL RING BEHIND AREN'S RIGHT FIST and ends at the fixed BLACK METAL POST on the upper-right BRIDGE. Show both ring and post clearly. One continuous narrow cyan line, NOT from blade, shoulder, torso, harness, left hand, Pell or the car. The silver crescent blade points up-left/away from the line and does not intersect it. Aren's right wrist and shoulder visibly bear the pull; left arm visibly bears Pell through their human grip. The magic pulls Aren and the person carried by his body toward the bridge; it does NOT lift the maintenance car.

GEOGRAPHY: stable inhabited bridge with railing and warm lamp at UPPER RIGHT; Aren/Pell centrally between it and the discarded car, both airborne, moving UP-RIGHT. The EMPTY black maintenance lift falls independently FARTHER DOWN-LEFT, well separated from both people, its broken thick suspension cable dangling into empty air. A small ordinary black slack safety strap and open clip can remain at the car rail, but there is NO tether of any kind from Pell's harness/body to the falling car. His harness stays WORN. No cable crosses the human grip or reconnects them to the car. No giant creature or attack in this panel.

CURRENT COST/STATE: Aren's ivory waist jacket lower HEM is ragged and torn as reference3. BOTH long sleeves are INTACT; no elbow/wrist/bicep hole yet and no blood. One red courier cord at his waist; original cream dispatch wallet may be occluded on front, do not put it on his back. No black envelope and no brass badge yet. Pell mustard workwear and ordinary harness only; no tall rig or extra gear. Adults moderately small against the city, but large enough that left rescue arm/right weapon arm and pommel endpoint can be read at phone width. Original Nightglass thin controlled anime lines, elegant human silhouettes, broad intentional navy/cyan atmosphere and sparse warm occupied windows, quiet dry matte bridge/stone and controlled glass/metal highlights; avoid allover speckle, gratuitous micrograin or decorative complexity at the grip. Clear, emotionally earned escape: two people rise toward safety while the empty car falls away.
